root_cause.text: The get-entries syscall paths in netfilter x_tables (IPv4, IPv6, ARP) copied the entire rule entry structure, including the raw percpu counter pointer in `entry->counters.pcnt`, to userspace before overwriting the counters with a sanitized snapshot, allowing a page fault during the initial copy to expose the kernel pointer.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `copy_to_user` calls from copying `sizeof(*e)` (the full entry) to copying only `offsetof(struct ipt_entry, counters)` (i.e., up to but not including the counters field), then separately copies the sanitized counters. The commit message explicitly states: "Copy only the fixed entry prefix before counters from the kernelized rule blob, then copy the sanitized counter snapshot into the counter field" and notes that "a caller can provide a userspace buffer that faults during the initial fixed-header copy after pcnt has been copied but before the later sanitized counter copy runs."
